role: RouteBaseline: the distance-weighted pace and sample-weighted HR totals over a route's prior runs, used by FitnessSummaryCards.routeHistorySummary. Split out of FitnessPostSummaryView+Cards.swift.
types: RouteBaseline: struct — summed distance/duration and HR sum/count over a route's prior runs, built by init(priorRuns:)
toplevel: Stored-property defaults are zero. No other top-level code.

units.does: Folds every prior run into the baseline via accumulatePace and accumulateHR (distance-weighted pace totals plus a sample-weighted HR sum/count).
Adds a prior run's distance and duration to the totals only when distance > 100 m and duration > 60 s.

branches.cond: distance missing/<=100 m or duration missing/<=60 s
branches.effect: return without contributing; else add distance and duration

units.does: Adds every positive per-sample heart rate of a prior run to the HR sum and count (sample-weighted, so longer runs weigh more; zero readings are strap dropouts).
